name: Dot X Active Window
description: Exposes the focused window's app id, title, and PID over D-Bus (org.dotx.ActiveWindow at /org/dotx/ActiveWindow on the org.gnome.Shell bus name) so that sandboxed/non-privileged apps like Dot X can read window focus on GNOME Wayland, where org.gnome.Shell.Eval and the built-in org.gnome.Shell.Introspect interface are both restricted. Read-only: it only ever reads global.display.focus_window, never modifies window state.
